description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class 'EmployeeWorkExperienceDaoTest' for testing the functionality of the 'EmployeeWorkExperienceDao' data access object related to employee work experience. It includes setup procedures, multiple test methods for CRUD operations, search, and counting employee work experience entries within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing EmployeeWorkExperienceDao's CRUD operations and search functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates the DAO instance, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee work experience by ID and employee number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests the deletion of employee work experience records.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests searching for employee work experience records with a filter.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeWorkExperienceWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching for employee work experience with a limit on results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee work experience record.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employee work experience record.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of employee work experience records matching a filter.
